body.message:
Good Afternoon,

Thank you for your message.

Yes, you may send your brother-in-law to collect the AED 2,000 deposit on your behalf. Kindly note that we will require a copy of his ID or passport for verification purposes.

Please be informed that deposit collection is available from Monday to Friday, between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM.

Kindly let us know in advance before he arrives, and we will share the contact details of the concerned person.

Thank you.
